{{Quote|They've undone everything we tried to do. They've turned this into a war with the Trade Federation and now the Republic.|The Bith on [[Eru Matalis]]'s actions|<ref name="cod" />}}
A '''Bith''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as one of the leaders of a pacifist faction of the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]]. Opposing the radical methods of [[Eru Matalis|Havac]] and his militant wing of their organization, the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] secretly passed information of the Front's activities to the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. Later on, the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] led the moderates of the Nebula Front in a [[Mission to Asmeru|revolution]] against their terrorist counterparts supported by the [[Ossan]] population of [[Asmeru/Legends|Asmeru]] and a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and officials representing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="cod" />
